item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:52 AM 26 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Samar(Marabut, Talalora, Daram), #Leyte(Babatngon), #Palawan(Balabac, SofronioEspanola, Narra), #EasternSamar(Guiuan, Mercedes, Salcedo and Hernani) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Samar(SantaRita, Pinabacdao, Basey, Villareal), #EasternSamar(GeneralMacarthur, Llorente, Balangkayan, Balangiga, Giporlos, Quinapondan, Lawaan), #Palawan(Rizal and Aborlan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
